scope: Real controller + isolated VM DOM; recommended legal deployment, first appearance and frozen skill instructions. No browser paint or hardware touch measured.

results.name: Static browser entry loads guide code and styles before the real UI controller
An unlocked hero is recommended in preflight, described in words, then really replaces a frozen initial slot
Recommendations obey legal same-system slots, two-unit cap, uniqueness and unlocks across all 42 missions
Player can cancel, switch position and restore recommendations without accidental deployment or resource spend
Confirmed joining story names the new ally, real skill and first legal mission in the result screen
First deployment guide offers the real skill, focus, full steps, and persistent acknowledgement outside battle saves
Every ordinary model gets an individual introduction and passive/self/target skills have matching operation steps
All five elites and all 15 frozen skills have accurate names, instruction modes and energy costs
Newly opened aura gets another guide, lower-level replay does not repeat a read milestone
First high-level appearance explains every open skill before one acknowledgement can mark it read
P2 first human turn and restored P2 turn use the actual viewer without exposing P1 or bypassing handoff
Engineer repair teaching matches the real command consuming all remaining action points
Ordinary targeting instructions match actual sniper movement, shock-unit, jammer-air and repair-ownership restrictions
Elite operation text distinguishes actual target modes, self support, attack permissions and each aura benefit
Acknowledged heroes stay read after reload, while a newly appearing ordinary model gets its own teaching card
Guides respect pause, AI, story, menus and fog; unknown enemy types never enter the player teaching queue
